manifest.description:
【音频生成】
关键节点：VAE 音频解码（把音频 latent 解码回音频）；采样器（用模型 + 正负条件去噪采样，生成图片）；Load Checkpoint（Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusio…）；Preview Audio（Preview the audio without saving it to the C…）；SheetSage2 Audio to ABC（Transcribes vocal and instrumental melodies…）；AudioSeparation（Separate audio into four sources: bass, drum…）；…（共 8 个）。
核心模型：底模 yue2_3b_bf16.safetensors。
输入：参考音频。
输出：音频。
可调参数：开始时间、结束时间、提示词（给出翻唱需求）。

paramNodes.title: CheckpointLoaderSimple
paramNodes.desc: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.

paramNodes.title: SheetSage2AudioToABC
paramNodes.desc: Transcribes vocal and instrumental melodies from music into ABC notation. Connect abc output to YuE2 Generate Music node and use the matching mode.

paramNodes.title: VAEDecodeAudio
paramNodes.desc: 把音频 latent 解码回音频。

paramNodes.title: KSampler
paramNodes.desc: 用模型 + 正负条件去噪采样，生成图片。

paramNodes.title: AudioSeparation
paramNodes.desc: Separate audio into four sources: bass, drums, other, and vocals.

paramNodes.title: AudioCrop
paramNodes.desc: Crop (trim) audio to a specific start and end time.

paramNodes.title: YuE2GenerateMusic
paramNodes.desc: Generates music tokens and acoustic conditioning from style, lyrics, and an ABC notation. Provide the generated seconds to the Empty YuE2 Latent Audio node. An empty ABC input ignores the selected mode.

paramNodes.title: Preview Audio
paramNodes.desc: Preview the audio without saving it to the ComfyUI output directory.
